hero.title: Invest for pretend. Learn for real.
hero.lead: Build portfolios with B3 stocks and REITs, follow real quotes and see how the news moves prices.

stage.title: Seven different tools. One screen.
stage.lead: Today, investors jump between their broker, news sites, charts and simulators. Here, everything talks to each other.

how.title: From the headline to the decision, in four moves.
how.lead: The path an experienced investor follows by heart, organized for people who are just starting.

build.title: Build
build.text: Create a portfolio with pretend money and pick real B3 stocks and REITs.

follow.title: Follow
follow.text: See real quotes, always with the time of each price. No real-time promises.

relate.title: Relate
relate.text: News shows up on the asset chart, classified as positive, neutral or negative.

learn.title: Learn
learn.text: Compare what you decided with what happened in the market and find out what you would do differently.

portfolios.title: Two ways to test an idea.

live.title: Live portfolio
live.text: Buy and sell now, with the latest available quote. The portfolio moves along with the market.

historic.title: Historical portfolio
historic.text: Pick a date in the past, build the portfolio and see what it would be worth today.
historic.quote: If I had invested, would I have gained or lost?

news.title: News with context, not with noise.
news.lead: Each article is linked to the assets it mentions and classified by tone. On the chart, you see what happened to the price afterwards.
news.note: We show possible relations, never certainties. Scenarios are educational estimates, not advice.

positive.title: Positive
positive.text: A favorable tone for the asset, such as profits above expectations.

neutral.title: Neutral or uncertain
neutral.text: A relevant fact with no clear direction, or an effect that is still hard to predict.

negative.title: Negative
negative.text: An unfavorable tone, such as a rule change that weighs on the sector.

stock.title: Stock
stock.text: A piece of a company. You gain when it grows in value and when it pays dividends and interest on equity.

reit.title: Real estate fund (FII)
reit.text: Shares of a fund that invests in real estate, such as warehouses and offices, and usually pays income every month.

tip.title: Ending in 11 does not mean FII.
tip.text: ETFs and units also end in 11. That is why each asset here has its class set at registration, like at brokers.

noMoney.title: No real money
noMoney.text: Every operation is simulated. There is no broker, no buy order and no real payment.

education.title: Education, not advice
education.text: We show scenarios and statistics. Recommending what to buy is regulated by the CVM, and that does not happen here.

password.title: Protected password
password.text: We only store a hash of your password, made with argon2id. Not even the team can read it.

privacy.title: Your data, your rules
privacy.text: You will be able to request the export or deletion of your data, as required by the LGPD.

cta.title: Your first portfolio starts with zero risk.
cta.lead: Create your free account and start learning from the real market.

footer.team: Luís Gustavo Sampaio Coêlho and Nicoly Araujo de Paschoa

p_l.name: P/E
p_l.help: Price divided by earnings per share: how many years of earnings would pay the current price.

p_vp.name: P/B
p_vp.help: Price divided by book value per share. Below 1, the share costs less than the equity it represents.

psr.name: P/Sales (PSR)
psr.help: Market value divided by revenue over the last 12 months.

ev_ebitda.name: EV/EBITDA
ev_ebitda.help: Enterprise value (market value plus net debt) divided by EBITDA: how many years of operating cash generation would pay for the company.

ev_ebit.name: EV/EBIT
ev_ebit.help: Enterprise value divided by operating profit (EBIT).

p_ebit.name: P/EBIT
p_ebit.help: Market value divided by operating profit (EBIT).

p_ativo.name: P/Assets
p_ativo.help: Market value divided by the company's total assets.

p_ativo_circ_liq.name: P/Net current assets
p_ativo_circ_liq.help: Market value divided by current assets minus all liabilities. Negative when debts exceed short-term assets.

p_cap_giro.name: P/Working capital
p_cap_giro.help: Market value divided by working capital (current assets minus current liabilities).

lpa.name: EPS
lpa.help: Earnings per share: earnings over the last 12 months divided by the number of shares.

vpa.name: BVPS
vpa.help: Book value per share: shareholders' equity divided by the number of shares.

margem_bruta.name: Gross margin
margem_bruta.help: What is left of revenue after the cost of what was sold.

margem_ebitda.name: EBITDA margin
margem_ebitda.help: EBITDA (operating result before depreciation) divided by revenue.

margem_liquida.name: Net margin
margem_liquida.help: Net income divided by revenue: how much of each real sold becomes profit.

giro_ativos.name: Asset turnover
giro_ativos.help: Revenue divided by total assets: how much the company sells for each real of assets.

roe.name: ROE
roe.help: Return on equity: net income divided by shareholders' equity.

roa.name: ROA
roa.help: Return on assets: net income divided by total assets.

roic.name: ROIC
roic.help: Return on the capital invested (equity plus debt) in operations.

dividend_yield.name: Dividend yield
dividend_yield.help: Dividends paid over the last 12 months divided by the current price.

payout.name: Payout
payout.help: Share of earnings paid out as dividends and interest on equity.

liquidez_corrente.name: Current ratio
liquidez_corrente.help: Current assets divided by current liabilities. Above 1, what falls due in the short term is covered.

div_liq_ebitda.name: Net debt/EBITDA
div_liq_ebitda.help: How many years of EBITDA would pay off the net debt.

div_liq_ebit.name: Net debt/EBIT
div_liq_ebit.help: How many years of operating profit would pay off the net debt.

div_liq_pl.name: Net debt/Equity
div_liq_pl.help: Net debt divided by shareholders' equity.

div_bruta_pl.name: Gross debt/Equity
div_bruta_pl.help: All financial debt divided by shareholders' equity.

pl_ativos.name: Equity/Assets
pl_ativos.help: Share of assets financed with the company's own capital.

passivos_ativos.name: Liabilities/Assets
passivos_ativos.help: Share of assets financed with debt and other obligations.

cagr_receitas_5a.name: Revenue CAGR (5 years)
cagr_receitas_5a.help: Average yearly revenue growth over the last 5 years.

cagr_lucros_5a.name: Earnings CAGR (5 years)
cagr_lucros_5a.help: Average yearly earnings growth over the last 5 years.

fii_dy_12m.name: Dividend yield (12 months)
fii_dy_12m.help: Distributions paid over the last 12 months divided by the current unit price.

fii_p_vp.name: P/B
fii_p_vp.help: Unit price divided by book value per unit. Below 1, the unit costs less than the equity it represents.

fii_vp_cota.name: Book value per unit
fii_vp_cota.help: The fund's equity divided by the number of units.

fii_valor_patrimonial.name: Fund equity
fii_valor_patrimonial.help: Everything the fund owns, minus what it owes.

fii_ultimo_rendimento.name: Last distribution
fii_ultimo_rendimento.help: The last amount distributed per unit.

fii_liquidez_diaria.name: Daily liquidity
fii_liquidez_diaria.help: How much is traded per day on the exchange, on average.

fii_vacancia.name: Vacancy
fii_vacancia.help: Share of the fund's properties without a tenant.

fii_cotistas.name: Unitholders
fii_cotistas.help: How many people and institutions hold units of the fund.

fii_cotas_emitidas.name: Units issued
fii_cotas_emitidas.help: How many units the fund has.
